rows.english: That's a grand name for a place like this.
…Lord Urugarm's guests…

…The only humans I ever knew were bandits, but…
I think I'd like to talk to you!

Sly one, isn't he?
Got guts, too, and a quick mind. Quite a man.

…One more to go?
So the lineup's still up in the air. Hmm…

Huh? It takes a special gift?
Aw. I was all set to show off this fine voice of mine.

It's peaceful enough to make you forget the clamor of the city,
yet it has all the bustle of a growing town…

Just a little joke, of course.
I would never dream of taking control by force.

My sole aim is to foster friendly relations.
That's what brings me here on this visit, after all.

I'll see to it that the local people benefit.
You needn't worry.

Now, now. Don't be too cross with her.
Your singing isn't so bad. That is to say…
Oh, it's no use. Best leave her be for a while.
Let's give her a little time to herself.

We must keep our wits about us
if we are to bring her safely back.
I heard the most beautiful singing a little while ago.

Oh, that was her singing!?
I'd never have guessed.

Even apart from their calling, those two
were lovely women, each irreplaceable.

They closely resemble humans, and our peoples have long been in contact.
Unlike goblins, for instance, they are highly intelligent and understand speech.
I suppose you might say our two peoples are friends on equal terms.

They have some fascinating traits.
For one thing, they retain a youthful appearance throughout their long lives.

She also fulfills her duties as a songstress admirably.
She even holds classes to teach others how to sing.

Hmm. I thought I might start stocking it, but…
I can't see much call for it. What to do…

Couldn't you help her too, adventurer?
Please, dear.

We all help each other when we're in a pinch.
I do hope she'll come and visit again.
Besides…
There's something on my mind.

That divine spirit… this Avaritia Shell, as you call it.
May I see the Imagine Seed that is said to have held it in check?

This Imagine Seed
is Adelaide's will in crystal form.
The spirit and the body are drawn to one another.
It seems someone has put their old technology to use again.
I never had any intention of going home.
I've lifted the barrier.

First there was the matter of Queen Pipimaruka's child,
and now this. Who are you, exactly?
May the forest grant you its blessing.
…What a lonely place.
Aaaaaah!
Someone's under attack!　We've got to help!

This is… Yes, there's no doubt.
It's an ancient weapon of the Bapharian gods.

What the Omnistron was reacting to…
was this thing?
Humans? What are you doing here…?
Urugarm, you say?!
And you lot beat it?
Ah!!　…It's you!

I remember you lot! When I snatched the Shell,
  you were the ones standing there looking like idiots!
Click to play.

Your first delivery? Oh, that's over by
the Transfer Portal at the Arena.

Looks like your next stop is by the Transfer Portal at the beach.
Good luck out there!

Word from the main temple in the Principality of Bernhardt?
Ho ho! I can finally go home!

So all that time I spent flattering my superiors has paid off.
Now then, let's have a look...

What are you gawking at?
Is my demotion that funny to you?!

...Ahh. A demotion, of all things.
No! I won't admit defeat! I wooon't!

What's the matter? Looking for your next stop?
Oh, I see. You're afraid you'll get lost.

Take a Transfer Portal to save yourself some time.
Go on, get that parcel to the person who's waiting for it.

Leave things here in the village to us.
We’ll make enough noise to draw the queen and her people away.

Make for the road first.
There should be fewer guards there soon.

Kapakuku said that when you set the queen's daughter free,
she appeared just as she was in life. Is that true?
Yes. I'd never seen anything like it myself.

Perhaps there is a difference between the soul of an Avaritia
and the soul of a pseudo-Avaritia.
I think... there was some comfort in that.

With things as they are, even Voldigen
will have trouble getting what he wants.

No, I too was unaware of the particulars.
Nor do I wish to cause needless friction with the forest folk.

If this gives the Order and the forest folk a chance
to mend their relations, I would welcome it.

My child can rest at last.
For that, I have all of you to thank.

Do not let hardship break your spirit.
Keep your eyes clear and follow the path you know you must take.

Peace and quiet in the forest again, po.
And it's all thanks to you, po.

You're friends of the forest now.
Come visit whenever you please, po.

Um...
Could you keep that between us?

Across the sea... No, more like beyond the sky.
It's so much farther away.

That reminds me. You're still trying
to get your memories back, aren't you?
Whew! Now that's the stuff!

It's new, and it goes down so smooth!
I can feel it in every engram in my body!

I sing for the offering by day and do research by night.
Got to let off steam sometimes.
Well, I think I'll grab another bottle!

Oh, hey. While you're here, let me buy you one.
Have a drink with me?

Call it a thank-you for everything.
I hear you've been working pretty hard yourself.

You've got time for a breather and a chat, right?
Let me treat you for once, huh?
Well, as long as you two hit it off, I'm glad.

W-wait a minute. That's a lot to take in...
Let me get this straight.

Let's see, that explains this...
and that takes care of that... Okay, got it!

Well, I don't mind telling you,
but you must keep it to yourselves.

First they packed me off to a lesser post in Minsterhorn,
and then there was this, and there was that...

I hope the people who read this in years to come
will face the Order with their eyes open! Ha ha ha ha ha!
Come, let's find whoever looks most important and ask them.
That much seems to be just as we remember, then.
Is the Avaritia Shell in there!?
Our god has need of your strength.
Ah, so that's it…

W-what manner of beast is this!?
It's in a different league from the others!
There… That should hold for a while…

Truly, you are the chosen of our god.
To think you felled that monster…

A king among beasts, it unleashes utter destruction with its charges and shock waves. As immovable as the earth itself, it attacks relentlessly with enough force to shatter mountains. Once it begins its rampage, slaying it is the only way to stop it, leaving no choice but a desperate fight to the death.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
It uses the combat experience accumulated over its many years of operation to improve its own capabilities. With overwhelming firepower, it can dominate vast areas and annihilate entire armies without allowing a single foe to escape.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
It does more than adapt to extreme cold. It releases such intense cold that it chills its surroundings, creating conditions that favor it. It will stop at nothing to bring down its target, relentlessly attacking until its prey is cornered.

A species of agile carnivore that races across the grasslands in packs.
A Land Fox variant adapted to life on the harsh tundra. Its exceptionally keen hearing lets it pinpoint the sounds of small animals hidden beneath the snow. Even a human holding their breath is easily detected.

A species of agile carnivore that races across the grasslands in packs.
It has survived the fierce struggle for life in the snowy mountains by giving free rein to its fighting instincts. It is also cunning, and is said to have learned to manipulate dark engrams to challenge larger creatures despite its small size.

The lord of the snowy mountains, commanding the beasts that dwell in the frozen wilds.
Proud and fearless, it challenges even dragons to battle. The flames within its body are said to burn away everything, from freezing winds to the mightiest foes.

A monster resembling a lizard larger than a human.
A Lizard Ghost that has evolved to survive in frozen lands. It conceals itself by mimicking the surrounding rocks and ice, then hunts prey that passes nearby. Its jaws are powerful enough to crush the frozen carcasses of other creatures.

A bird of prey monster that hunts even large animals.
A Landhawk variant that makes its territory in bitterly cold lands. Its dense plumage offers excellent insulation, allowing it to soar undisturbed through any weather. It is not uncommon for one to burst from a raging blizzard and carry off its prey.

A bird of prey monster that hunts even large animals.
A mysterious Landhawk that roams the skies of the ice world. Its face is badly damaged, and ice engrams spill from its scars. It has reportedly displayed the strange behavior of using these engrams to whip up a blizzard and hide within it.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
Sinister engrams seep through the gaps between scales far harder than steel. Its blazing stare is said to make even the mightiest warriors tremble. Only by overcoming that terror can one earn the right to face it in battle.

A mysterious creature of unknown origin.
It can be found in regions blanketed by wind and snow. Known for shimmering like an aurora, it is said to bring good fortune to anyone who encounters it. One theory even claims it has a bit of a cold.

An outlaw who makes a hideout outside towns or deep in the mountains.
Said to have once held a respectable position before being cast out for wrongdoing. Far too intelligent and skilled for an ordinary bandit, this foe can overwhelm anyone who lets their guard down.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
The bitter regrets of nameless heroes brought down by schemes, plots, and conspiracies have coalesced into a dark, burning mass. Hesitate for even an instant, and its overwhelming storm of attacks will sweep you away. Those who give in to fear can scarcely fight it at all.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
The fire engrams pouring from it generate such intense heat that it seems liable to melt its own body. Even its gaze is said to ignite what it falls upon. Only those with exceptional resolve and skill can hope to confront it.

A Dragon Tribe warrior with an imposing physique and overwhelming strength.
Though immature and lacking in intellect, it can rival even Voldigen in a contest of raw power. Its brutish nature makes it impossible to stop once it rampages, crushing everything in its path.

A grotesque monster said to have been "born of flame and calamity." The hellfire within spills out to engulf its immense body, yet loses none of its fury as it burns everything around it. A symbol of ill omen, its very appearance is feared as "a harbinger of terrible disaster."

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
Buffeted by a cruel fate, it destroys all around it as its anguished cries echo through the air. The sight is both terrifying and tragic. Perhaps someone who has attained true strength can free it from its suffering.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
Much of its nature remains a mystery, but there is no doubt that it wields immense strength. Some of the calamities described in ancient legends may well refer to the devastation wrought by its varied and ferocious attacks.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
Its firepower and mobility have both been greatly improved. Enhanced for more tactical deployment, it can launch wide-area attacks and charges. It can adapt to any situation and is devastating in battles of annihilation.

The mightiest Dragon King, whose name resounds across the planet Regnas.
So powerful and terrifying that none may even approach, it is an absolute threat. Across the thousands of years of dragon history, past and future alike, no equal exists.

A mysterious warrior of unknown origins.
Once hailed as a hero powerful enough to change the course of the world, they are now a shadow of their former self. Their skill, however, remains undiminished. They have become a demon, beheading one enemy after another with lightning speed.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
Its strength is said to exceed the bounds of humanity. Look away for an instant, and your head may already be falling. The way it slaughters its enemies without a word may indeed be beyond anything human.

A powerful monster known to have inhabited Koaniani Forest since ancient times. Its appearances cause such devastation that they are counted among the forest's natural disasters. It is remembered as one of the greatest threats in the forest's long history. Anyone who faces it must be prepared to overcome the fury of nature itself.

They skim the ground as though mowing down undergrowth, attacking their prey in swarms. They appear near Forest Reapers and slip in attacks to cover the openings left by their massive companions. Leaving them unchecked can turn a battle into an unexpectedly difficult fight.

Always appears lurking in the Forest Reaper's shadow, relying on its intimidating presence. It is rarely a threat on its own, but its interference during a fight with the Forest Reaper is both troublesome and extremely dangerous.

A Forest Reaper transformed by the vast stores of ice engrams accumulated within its body. It scatters ice and snow from its massive frame like a raging blizzard, making even an approach difficult. It freezes all life, shrouding the forest in the silence of death. It is said that nothing moves in its wake.
A Tiny Reaper cloaked in ice engrams. It releases cold air to stagger its enemies and make escape easier. It usually hides behind other monsters and rarely ventures to the front.

A pleasant breeze sweeps through these hills.
In the village of Minsterhorn, the steady wind keeps
the famous local windmills turning.

A trade route to Ritze has crossed these foothills since ancient times.
Recent attacks like the one on Bergmar Village have given the route
a reputation for danger. Goblins have a settlement here, too.
Even the Oracle Priestess now takes seasoned guards with her
when she makes her pilgrimage.

The famed Great Cave of Ritze follows the Melisos River.
The scenery is famous, too. Falling Dragon Falls is
so steep they say even dragons tumble over the brink.
At the eastern edge, the Arid Valley Checkpoint leads
to the desert. Guards stand watch to keep people safe.

The knights who are the pride of the Principality of Bernhardt
fought the dragonfolk time and again on this battlefield.
The ruined fortresses, crumbling buildings, and wrecked gun emplacements
still bear witness to the ferocity of those battles.
Menacing Dragon Ridge

A mountainous region in the northern Granville Ice World.
Fierce blizzards and active volcanoes make this land so harsh
that it is said no living creature can survive here.
Deep within towers the sacred Mount Bernardus, a place so remote
that it is known as the end of the world.
White Dragon Snowfield

A snowy region in the southern Granville Ice World.
Despite its relentless winds, snow, and bitter cold,
it is considered one of the more manageable parts of the Granville Ice World.
Known as the home of dragonkind, it is avoided by most people.
Stellar Aurora

Beautiful ribbons of light stream across the night sky over the Granville Ice World.
Known as the Stellar Aurora, this phenomenon remains shrouded in mystery.
It only occurs rarely, so if you see it,
try taking a picture in Photo Mode.

and eventually shatters, leaving a hole.
Falling through a hole may force you to take a detour,
but it can also lead you to hidden gathering points.

Intermediate Combat Tips

■ Watch who enemies target
Attacking or healing makes enemies more likely to target you.
On the front line, keep enemies from targeting the back line.
On the back line, avoid drawing their attention.
If you want to avoid becoming a target,
watch the Aggro Alert. Try attacking when it's yellow
or attacking less often.

■ Check your gear's abilities
Check weapon Special Effects, Attributes,
and Imagine abilities. Copies of the same item
can have different Special Effects or abilities.
Equipped copies of an ability add up. Find gear
with abilities that suit your class and equip it.

■ Experiment with your Battle Build
Try Class Abilities that cover your weaknesses
or a low-damage Battle Imagine that inflicts
status ailments. Consider how effects combine.

■ Level up different classes
At class level 30, you unlock a slot for Shared Abilities.
Use it to equip a Shared Ability from another class.
Learn Shared Abilities from several classes
to give yourself more options in battle.
